code:
pg_upgrade -b oldbin -B newbin -d olddata -D newdata

Copy mode (default)
  copies data files -> slower, old cluster stays as fallback

Link mode (--link)
  hard-links data files -> much faster, no fallback cluster
caption: Either mode is in-place: there's a maintenance window while the upgrade runs.
